store.summary: Control your Cardputer from a browser: screen, shell, files, apps and Wi-Fi
store.description: Open ZeroDesk and it shows an address and a one-time pairing code. Enter them in a browser on the same network to get a live view of the Cardputer's screen (typing, paste, screenshots, recordings), a shell, a file browser, store installs, Wi-Fi and VPN controls, and CPU, memory, battery and network stats. HTTPS and local network only; runs as your user; admin actions ask for your password. Remote typing works after one reboot.
